requirements: Run ./gradlew -p ui check --no-build-cache and root ./gradlew check -x test -Prefguide.include=false; record commands, formatting, JVM and wasm results, skips, counts and evidence.

Exercise 401 and 403 for both collection and handler discovery, a 5xx response and success, using a client that returns the response; verify correct request-specific messages and suppressed empty-state messages.

Use secured Solr with rule-based authorization to check a query-capable user denied collection discovery, a user allowed collection discovery but denied configuration access, and a user allowed both. Record policies, actual status codes and UI behavior.

This branch is stacked on index-query-main-section at 7fa00860af3f335c6611410314ed9ec69ac5c70e and omits the separate bearer callback fix. Do not claim OAuth 401 coverage without a combined-head proof.
Exercise the main Index and Query navigation and confirm the Configsets tab remains separate.
